Psr_CharIsSpace
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsSpace( char c )   { return (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n');                           }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsSpace(c byte) int32 { return (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n');                           }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsDigit
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsDigit( char c )   { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9');                                                      }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsDigit(c byte) int32 { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9');                                                      }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsDigitB
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsDigitB( char c )  { return (c == '0' || c == '1'  || c == 'x' || c == 'z');                             }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsDigitB(c byte) int32 { return (c == '0' || c == '1'  || c == 'x' || c == 'z');                             }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsDigitH
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsDigitH( char c )  { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f');  }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsDigitH(c byte) int32 { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f');  }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsChar
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsChar( char c )    { return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z');                            }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsChar(c byte) int32 { return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z');                            }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsSymb1
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsSymb1( char c )   { return Psr_CharIsChar(c) || c == '_';                                               }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsSymb1(c byte) int32 { return Psr_CharIsChar(c) || c == '_';                                               }

Functions.Name: Psr_CharIsSymb2
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_CharIsSymb2( char c )   { return Psr_CharIsSymb1(c) || Psr_CharIsDigit(c) || c == '$';                        }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_CharIsSymb2(c byte) int32 { return Psr_CharIsSymb1(c) || Psr_CharIsDigit(c) || c == '$';                        }

Functions.Name: Psr_ManIsChar
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_ManIsChar( Psr_Man_t * p, char c )    { return p->pCur[0] == c;                        }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_ManIsChar(p *Psr_Man_t, c byte) int32 { return p.pCur[0] == c;                        }

Functions.Name: Psr_ManIsChar1
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_ManIsChar1( Psr_Man_t * p, char c )   { return p->pCur[1] == c;                        }
Functions.Draft: func Psr_ManIsChar1(p *Psr_Man_t, c byte) int32 { return p.pCur[1] == c;                        }

Functions.Name: Psr_ManIsDigit
Functions.Original: static inline int Psr_ManIsDigit( Psr_Man_t * p )           { return Psr_CharIsDigit(*p->pCur);              }
